## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle separate verse-text containing the *kārikā* of [KR6n0077](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0077) *Xiǎnyáng shèngjiào lùn* (T31n1602) extracted as a stand-alone aide-memoire. Translated by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) in 645–646, in the same campaign as the prose treatise. One fascicle.

**Abstract**

The separate-verse-text format reflects standard Indian curricular practice of memorising the verse-base of a śāstra independently of its prose exposition. Although the verses reproduce material already present in [KR6n0077](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0077), they were extracted and translated separately by Xuánzàng's team for the convenience of advanced students.

The dating bracket follows the parallel translation of T1602 (645–646). The text is brief and is not cited extensively in the commentarial tradition — the prose work [KR6n0077](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0077) supplies the doctrinal substance and is the principal reference text.
